compare.title: Give Up
compare.instruction: Clear Floors 1–5 and reach Floor 6. Reach each floor's exit with the cyan runner. Use Left/Right to steer and Up to jump; release and press Up again in the air to double-jump. Deaths automatically retry the current floor.

compare.title: Fair Squares
compare.instruction: Accept the offered upgrade, then clear all three waves of the following red-world arena. You begin between two portals after the first arena: walk into the left portal under the blue upgrade text to accept both the player and enemy modifiers. The right portal marked "i'm good" declines this offer.

compare.title: Alfonzo's Bowling Challenge
compare.instruction: Destroy all forty bricks in the breakout round.
